seo.title: The Alderton — Boutique Luxury Hotel London
seo.description: A beautifully restored Georgian townhouse hotel in Mayfair, offering refined rooms and exceptional service.
seo.keywords: boutique hotel, luxury hotel, London, Mayfair, B&B, rooms

hero.headline: Where London Meets Luxury
hero.subheadline: A beautifully restored Georgian townhouse hotel in the heart of Mayfair — timeless elegance, modern comfort.

services.sectionSubtitle: Each room is individually designed and hand-sourced with antiques and fine textiles.

items.title: Deluxe Room
items.description: An elegant retreat with a king bed, marble en-suite, and courtyard views.

items.title: Superior Room
items.description: Elevated comfort with a four-poster bed, walk-in wardrobe, and garden views.

items.title: Mayfair Suite
items.description: Expansive two-room suite with a private drawing room, butler service, and panoramic views.

items.title: Penthouse
items.description: Our crowning jewel — a full-floor retreat with a terrace and private access.

items.quote: Truly the finest boutique hotel in London. The suite was extraordinary — we will return.
items.name: Victoria L.

items.quote: Impeccable service from the moment we arrived. Every detail was thoughtful and elegant.
items.name: Thomas H.

items.question: What time is check-in/check-out?
items.answer: Check-in from 3 PM, check-out by 11 AM. Early/late available on request.

items.question: Is breakfast included?
items.answer: Breakfast is included in the Deluxe, Superior, and Suite rates.

items.question: Do you accommodate events or private dining?
items.answer: Yes — our private dining room seats up to 20 guests. Contact us for arrangements.

about.body: Built in 1847 and painstakingly restored in 2010, The Alderton preserves its original Georgian architecture while offering every modern comfort. We are family-owned and independently operated.

ctaBanner.headline: Reserve Your Room Today
ctaBanner.subtext: Complimentary champagne on arrival for stays of 3 nights or more.

booking.sectionSubtitle: Select your room and preferred dates and our team will confirm within 4 hours.
